captions.detailed: This object is a pair of rangefinder binoculars colored in a matte dark gray/black finish. It features two wide, rounded rectangular optical barrels connected by a central hinge mechanism. A central focus wheel is mounted vertically on the hinge bridge, and a small cylindrical mode selector dial with an orange pointer sits atop the right barrel. The two main barrels can rotate around the central bridge to adjust interpupillary distance, while the focus wheel and selector dial rotate on their respective axes.

captions.factory: The model is built by creating several parts. The central hinge bridge serves as the base, constructed from combined cylinders and boxes. The left and right barrels are constructed by lofting or combining boxy housings with cylindrical lens tubes and eyepieces. The focus wheel is built using a thin cylinder oriented vertically on the central bridge. The mode selector dial on the right barrel is built from a small cylinder topped with a thin orange rectangular indicator box. Revolute articulations are defined for the left and right barrels rotating around the central hinge axis, the focus wheel rotating about its central axis, and the selector dial rotating on its local vertical axis.
